title: Somalia's Disaster Agency Rallies Diaspora Support Ahead of El Niño Floods
detail: Somalia's National Disaster Management Agency (SoDMA) held a virtual meeting with Somali diaspora representatives to prepare for anticipated El Niño-linked flooding expected between September and December 2026. SoDMA's chairman called on diaspora communities to contribute to relief efforts, early-warning systems, and public-awareness campaigns, warning that heavy rainfall and rising river levels along the Juba and Shabelle basins put more than 274,000 people on the Shabelle floodplain at risk. By August 18, Somalia and its humanitarian partners had intensified preparedness — including risk analysis, contingency planning, and pre-positioning of relief supplies — with the Somali Air Force also agreeing to support emergency relief and rescue operations in hard-to-reach areas.
